title: Mitosis Stage Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AP Biology
description: Interactive diagram overlay showing the five stages of mitosis with 15 callout markers for key structures, featuring Explore and Quiz modes.

learningObjectives: Identify each stage of mitosis by its chromosome appearance and cellular structures
Explain the key molecular events driving each stage of mitosis
Describe the role of the spindle assembly checkpoint in preventing aneuploidy
Compare the mechanisms of cytokinesis in animal cells vs plant cells
prerequisites: Cell cycle phases (G1, S, G2, M)
standards: AP Biology Unit 10: Cell Cycle, Mitosis, and Cancer

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive exploration with callout markers and quiz mode
keyQuestions: What happens to chromosomes during each stage of mitosis?
Why is the spindle assembly checkpoint important for preventing cancer?
How does the contractile ring divide the cell during cytokinesis?
What is the difference between chromatin and chromosomes?
commonMisconceptions: Students confuse chromatids with chromosomes when counting
Students think the metaphase plate is a physical structure
Students forget that nuclear envelope breakdown occurs in prophase
Students confuse animal cell cytokinesis (cleavage furrow) with plant cell cytokinesis (cell plate)
assessmentOpportunities: Quiz mode: identify all 15 structures by clicking correct markers
Stage ordering: name the 5 stages in correct sequence
